CG construction API details¶

The recommended reactive entry point is described in Core API.

.. py:function:: build_pygamd_protocol(config, output_dir=’pygamd_protocol’, *, xml_name=’initial.xml’, runner_name=’run_pygamd_polymerization.py’, use_builtin=False, with_cg_ff=False, mass_density=0.9, default_bond_length=1.0, minimum_distance=None, n_conformers=10, random_seed=2026, include_dihedrals=False) :module: chemfast.cg.pipeline

.. py:function:: get_cgff_parameters(config, output=’cg_parameters.json’, **kwargs) :module: chemfast.cg.pipeline

.. py:function:: build_cg_system(config, output=’cg_system.xml’, n_conformers=10, include_dihedrals=False, random_seed=2026, default_bond_length=1.0, bond_k=1100.0, angle_k=25.0, dihedral_k=5.0) :module: chemfast.cg.pipeline

build_pygamd_protocol writes files but does not launch MD. The generated run_pygamd_polymerization.py requires a separately installed PyGAMD backend.
